links.outcome: Safety issues in GPT-4-generated diabetes management plans
links.effect: Safety issues were noted in 16% of GPT-4-generated plans, indicating that unverified AI plans could carry risk.
links.quote: Safety issues were noted in 16% of the plans generated by GPT-4, highlighting potential risks associated with AI-generated management plans.

links.outcome: Completeness and necessity of medications in GPT-4 plans versus guideline-based reference plan
links.effect: Physicians' plans had fewer missing medications than GPT-4 (p=0.008). GPT-4 plans included fewer unnecessary medications (p=0.003). Dosage accuracy (p=0.975) and overall error scores (p=0.301) did not differ.
links.quote: Results indicated that physicians' management plans had fewer missing medications compared to those generated by GPT-4 (p=0.008).

screen.reason: The study evaluates GPT-4 versus physicians on generating diabetes management plans from anonymized patient records. It assesses LLM accuracy and safety offline, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
